title: Credits Arising from Corporate Agreement Tickets — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
Where an instrument of Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers restricts corporate-origin redemption, a credit whose source ticket carries a corporate agreement under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements may pay only for a ticket booked under that same corporate agreement, because the company paid the original fare. While that agreement is active, the credit cannot be used for personal travel.

**Authorisation condition.** A restricted credit is redeemed only on a new ticket whose corporate agreement is the same as the source ticket's corporate agreement. The source ticket's corporate agreement in the system record is the evidence.

**Pooling.** Where the agreement tier permits credit pooling across travelers under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements, such a credit may also pay for another active roster traveler's ticket under the same agreement. For that purpose only, this overrides a named-traveler-only traveler scope.

**Termination.** When the agreement is terminated the restriction lapses, and the credit may be used by the named traveler for any booking its traveler scope allows.

**Unrestricted credits.** Credits from tickets not booked under a corporate agreement carry no such restriction, and neither do instruments that do not restrict corporate-origin redemption.

## Decision matrix (hypothetical bookings)

| Source ticket | Agreement | New ticket | Redemption |
|---|---|---|---|
| Booked under agreement K | active | booked under agreement K for the named traveler | Allowed |
| Booked under agreement K | active | personal booking | Not allowed while the agreement is active |
| Booked under agreement K | active, tier pools credits across travelers | booked under K for another active roster traveler | Allowed, for that purpose only |
| Booked under agreement K | active, tier does not pool credits | booked under K for another traveler | Not allowed on a named-traveler-only credit |
| Booked under agreement K | terminated | personal booking by the named traveler | Allowed within the traveler scope |
| Not booked under an agreement | none | any booking the traveler scope allows | No corporate restriction |
